verdict.rationale: PagerDuty hosts an interactive OpenAPI reference at developer.pagerduty.com covering its REST, Events, SCIM, MCP and integration APIs. Users can browse endpoints, schemas and code samples, and send requests directly from the docs through a try-it console. Public OpenAPI schemas are also published and can be imported into Postman. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the try-it console works as described.
